findings.description: `extractFilenameFromUrl()` extracts basenames to prevent escapes, but verify that `path.basename()` is applied to the pathname component before joining with `uploadsDir`.

findings.issue: Stale cover reference on URL unreachability
findings.description: If a selected cover URL becomes unreachable between frontend validation and backend update, the stale reference is saved without detection. Add URL reachability check or accept this as a data resilience trade-off.
`deleteProject()` does not remove associated image files, orphaning uploads. Extend the delete controller to clean up files, or document this as a maintenance task.

findings.issue: Concurrent edit conflicts on image removal
findings.description: Two simultaneous edits that both remove the same image will race on file deletion. Current error handling is safe, but add concurrency guards (e.g., soft-delete flags, locking) if concurrent edits become common.
